name: spacing-skill
description: Apply a consistent spacing scale, readable rhythm, and contextual alignment to interfaces and documents.

interface.shortDescription: Consistent spacing, readable rhythm, and alignment
interface.longDescription: Read the existing layout and tokens, select contextual density, and apply one spacing scale across interfaces or written documents. Works with packaged guidance; no external account or MCP server is required.
defaultPrompt: Review this interface for spacing, density, and alignment.
Improve the paragraph and heading rhythm of this document.
